frozen_rules.pre_stability: >=3 consecutive weekly observations under A before change
frozen_rules.post_persistence: B at event plus >=4 further consecutive weekly observations (>=28d lower bound)
frozen_rules.unit: cluster all qualifying prefixes sharing transition week and A->B pair; deterministic representative prefix
frozen_rules.recurrence: flag/exclude if old A is observed again at a weekly checkpoint within 8 weeks

guardrail: This enumerator detects persistent observed single-origin replacements in weekly RouteViews rv2 snapshots. It does not by itself establish transfer intent, stale authorization, or global visibility.
